title: Corned beef and cabbage
ingredients: 1 3–4 lb corned beef brisket with spice packet
steps: Rinse brisket. Cover with water, add spice packet and onion. Simmer gently 2 1/2–3 hours until tender.
Add potatoes and carrots; cook 20 minutes. Add cabbage; cook 15 minutes more.
Slice beef across the grain. Serve with vegetables and mustard.
